# plural_monitor (Resource)

Monitor resource. A monitor periodically evaluates a log or metrics query of a service deployment against a threshold and fires alerts when it is crossed. When attached to a workbench, it can also start a workbench investigation when it fires.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `evaluation_cron` (String) Cron schedule defining when the monitor is evaluated, e.g. `*/5 * * * *`.
- `name` (String) Short name used to identify this monitor.
- `query` (Attributes) Query used to fetch data for this monitor. Exactly one of `log` or `metrics` has to be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query))
- `service_id` (String) ID of the service deployment this monitor is attached to.
- `severity` (String) Severity level applied to alerts generated by this monitor. Allowed values include `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, `CRITICAL` and `UNDEFINED`.
- `threshold` (Attributes) Threshold that determines when the monitor fires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--threshold))
- `type` (String) Monitor data type. It has to match the query, i.e. `LOG` requires `query.log` and `METRICS` requires `query.metrics`. Allowed values include `LOG` and `METRICS`.

### Optional

- `alert_template` (String) Template used when rendering alert messages for this monitor.
- `description` (String) Description of what this monitor is checking.
- `modes` (Attributes) Mode-specific options for workbench jobs started by this monitor. Requires `workbench_id`, as jobs are only started for monitors attached to a workbench. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modes))
- `prompt` (String) Prompt used when the monitor starts a workbench investigation. Requires `workbench_id`.
- `workbench_id` (String) ID of the workbench this monitor is attached to. When set, the monitor can start a workbench investigation when it fires. It is required if the query uses a named workbench tool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal identifier of this monitor.

<a id="nestedatt--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query`

Optional:

- `log` (Attributes) Log query used when the monitor type is `LOG`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--log))
- `metrics` (Attributes) Metrics query used when the monitor type is `METRICS`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--query--log"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.log`

Required:

- `bucket_size` (String) Time bucket size used when aggregating log results, e.g. `5m`.
- `query` (String) Log query string passed to the underlying log provider.

Optional:

- `duration` (String) Lookback duration for the log query, e.g. `1h`.
- `facets` (Attributes List) Key/value facets applied as additional filters on the log query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--log--facets))
- `operator` (String) Operator used when combining multiple log queries. Defaults to `OR`. Allowed values include `OR` and `AND`.
- `options` (Attributes) Provider-specific log query options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--log--options))
- `tool` (String) Name of the workbench logs tool. When not set, the native Plural logs provider is used.

<a id="nestedatt--query--log--facets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.log.facets`

Required:

- `key` (String) Facet key, e.g. a Kubernetes namespace or pod label name.
- `value` (String) Facet value to match for the given key.


<a id="nestedatt--query--log--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.log.options`

Optional:

- `azure` (Attributes) Azure log query options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--log--options--azure))

<a id="nestedatt--query--log--options--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.log.options.azure`

Optional:

- `resource_id` (String) Azure resource ID to query logs for.




<a id="nestedatt--query--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.metrics`

Required:

- `query` (String) Metrics query string passed to the underlying metrics provider.

Optional:

- `duration` (String) Lookback duration for the metrics query, e.g. `1h`.
- `options` (Attributes) Provider-specific metrics query options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--metrics--options))
- `step` (String) Metrics query step, e.g. `5m`.
- `tool` (String) Name of the workbench metrics tool. When not set, the native Plural metrics provider is used.

<a id="nestedatt--query--metrics--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.metrics.options`

Optional:

- `azure` (Attributes) Azure metrics query options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--metrics--options--azure))

<a id="nestedatt--query--metrics--options--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.metrics.options.azure`

Optional:

- `aggregation` (String) Azure metrics aggregation type.
- `filter` (String) Azure metrics filter expression.
- `metrics_endpoint` (String) Azure metrics endpoint override.
- `metrics_namespace` (String) Azure metrics namespace.
- `order_by` (String) Azure metrics ordering expression.
- `resource_id` (String) Azure resource ID to query metrics for.
- `roll_up_by` (String) Azure metrics dimension to roll up by.





<a id="nestedatt--threshold"></a>
### Nested Schema for `threshold`

Required:

- `aggregate` (String) Aggregation function applied over the result set. Allowed values include `MAX`, `MIN` and `AVG`.
- `value` (Number) Value the aggregated result has to cross to fire the alert.


<a id="nestedatt--modes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modes`

Optional:

- `budget` (Attributes) Budget limits for the job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modes--budget))
- `coding` (Attributes) Coding mode options for the job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modes--coding))
- `kubernetes` (Attributes) Kubernetes action options for the job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modes--kubernetes))
- `model` (Attributes) AI model override for the job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modes--model))
- `plan` (Boolean) Whether planning mode is enabled for the job.

<a id="nestedatt--modes--budget"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modes.budget`

Optional:

- `cost` (Number) Maximum cost budget for the job.
- `tokens` (Number) Maximum token budget for the job.


<a id="nestedatt--modes--coding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modes.coding`

Optional:

- `approval` (Boolean) Whether coding agent runs require approval before continuing.
- `babysit` (Boolean) Whether babysit mode is enabled for coding agent runs.
- `review` (Boolean) Whether pull request review mode is enabled for coding agent runs.


<a id="nestedatt--modes--kubernetes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modes.kubernetes`

Optional:

- `delete` (Boolean) Whether Kubernetes delete actions are enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `drain` (Boolean) Whether Kubernetes node drain actions are enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `exclude_namespaces` (Set of String) Namespaces the agent can never act in.
- `exec` (Boolean) Whether Kubernetes exec actions are enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `require_namespaces` (Set of String) If set, the agent can only act in these namespaces.
- `update` (Boolean) Whether Kubernetes update actions are enabled. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--modes--model"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modes.model`

Required:

- `model` (String) Model name for the job.
- `provider` (String) AI provider for the job. Allowed values include `OPENAI`, `ANTHROPIC`, `OLLAMA`, `AZURE`, `BEDROCK`, `VERTEX`, `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE` and `XAI`.
